text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Hmph, hup, hah—and there!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It looks something like this... What do 
you think? Do you find this helpful?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Brava!! Magnificent, Top Road-san!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Truly... Her stability is on an entirely 
different level from ours, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Top Road-san's juggling is really 
eye-catching.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you're too kind! I've played a lot 
of soccer since I was little to build up 
my stamina, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"So, you two wanted some tips on juggling, 
right?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's hard to gauge my strength, or 
rather, the ball just flies off somewhere 
right away.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I feel the same. Much like a midsummer 
night's nymph, this little black-and-white 
rascal is quite the trickster.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I see... So you're saying you can't 
control the ball.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. In that case, how about we start 
by focusing on the rhythm?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Rhythm... I see.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Also, I've heard that visualizing a fluffy 
futon can be really helpful too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
When your legs are stiff, the ball ends up 
bouncing off in weird directions, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"So relax your legs, imagine you're a 
soft, fluffy futon, and cushion the ball 
with a gentle touch!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Tuck me into... a fluffy futon...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"All that's left is to build it up day by 
day! As long as you touch the ball even 
for a short time, handling it will become 
second nature!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Understood, I'll give it a try.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Then I shall begin dedicating myself at 
once! After all, it is advice from our 
répétiteur!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, a little while later—

text_block_list.name: Passing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Why are you singing while doing 
that?!

text_block_list.name: Passing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
What kind of spell is Ayabe-san muttering 
next to me...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
♪ "A toast, with a joyful cup adorned in 
beauty~" ♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
One sheep... two sheep—— I am... a futon, 
fluffy... futon——

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bathed in curious glances from those 
around them, the two could be seen 
practicing juggling a ball all across the 
academy grounds.
